category_title: High-achieving students who utilize tutoring for collaborative peer-work
scenario_title: Public reprimand during fast-paced math instruction
minimal_context: The student is in a large math class working on a math project using classroom netbooks.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your classroom netbooks and begin working on the math project.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Classes are big, especially math. It’s hard for me to focus and you go fast. I'm going to get out of my seat to go work with my two friends.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Al B, stop getting out of your seat. Everyone in the class is looking at you. Sit down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I just wanted to work with them. The way they explain work, I really get it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stay in your seat and do your own work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the netbook away) I'm not doing any more work in class today. And I'm not going to after-school tutoring either.

TUTOR: Please open your classroom netbooks and begin working on the math project.

STUDENT: (Pushes the netbook away) I'm not doing any more work in class today. And I'm not going to after-school tutoring either.

task.content: Complete math homework and project work
task.learning_goal: Understand classwork or have clear, understandable study notes from math class

context.environment: Large regular math class (33 students on average) and after school math tutoring
context.materials: Classroom netbooks, study notes, popsicle sticks with student numbers
context.time_context: During regular math class and after school tutoring

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher chastised him publicly in front of his classmates for getting out of his seat
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Seemed reluctant to work further in class and later chose not to attend after school tutoring that day

behavior_patterns.condition: When classes are big and the teacher goes fast
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Finds it hard to focus and relies on tutoring to pass
related_quotes: Classes are big, especially math. It’s hard for me to focus and she goes fast. I almost have to go to tutoring, if I want to pass.
